分页查询时每页行数。

- 最大值：500

description.en:
The number of entries per page.

*   Maximum value: 500.
*   Default value: 20.

description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available.

The type of the storage resource.

*   NAS: NAS storage
*   PDS: PDS storage
